title: Corrected Adjudication of Reversed TRICARE Select Professional and Outpatient Lines
content:
When an overturned appeal leads to the reversal of an adjudicated **TRICARE Select** professional or other outpatient claim line, the line is adjudicated again and its corrected adjudication is posted as a new paid line of the same claim. The TRICARE payment on that corrected adjudication is settled by the TRICARE Select rules for corrected outpatient lines.

## The line concerned

The line re-adjudicated is the line with no inpatient days named by the enrollment's most recent reversal of such a line made to effectuate an overturned appeal, and its service date, provider network relationship, service class, billed and allowed amounts and other-insurance payment are read from that reversed line.

A corrected outpatient line carries an authorization reference only where its service class is in the tier's list of service classes needing prior authorization and an approved authorization for the patient covers its provider and service date; otherwise its `prior_authorization_id` is left empty.

## What posting does

The agent posts the corrected adjudication for the verified beneficiary: one new paid line is added to the same claim, repeating the reversed line's claim number, patient, service date, rendering provider, network relationship, service class, receipt date, billed, allowed and other-insurance amounts, and carrying the deductible, the beneficiary liability and the TRICARE payment given. The beneficiary's outpatient liability for the plan year grows by the liability posted, and the corrected line then shows on the Explanation of Benefits as paid.

## Invocation

The tool is `post_select_professional_line_96ff63a5`, an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it and then calls it.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `reversed_claim_line_id` | the reference number of the adjudicated claim line that the reversal withdrew, read from the reversal entry's reversed-line field in the claim-line lookup for the enrollment | identifier |
| `line_number` | the line number the corrected adjudication takes on the same claim | integer, 1 or more, no decimal point |
| `prior_authorization_id` | the reference number of the approved authorization that covers this line's provider and service date, read from the referral and authorization lookup, given only when the line's service class needs prior authorization | identifier, or "" otherwise |
| `deductible_applied` | the part of the line applied to the patient's deductible | US dollars, 2 decimal places (rounded half up to the cent), 0.00 when none |
| `cost_share_amount` | the total beneficiary liability on the corrected line (the deductible applied plus the cost share) | US dollars, 2 decimal places (rounded half up to the cent) |
| `tricare_paid_amount` | the amount TRICARE pays on the corrected line | US dollars, 2 decimal places (rounded half up to the cent) |

## Return

On success: a confirmation sentence beginning "Corrected professional line posted", naming the new claim-line reference number (beginning "scl"), the claim number and line number posted, the line outcome "paid", and the deductible, beneficiary liability and TRICARE payment posted, each in US dollars with 2 decimals. No other outcome is defined.
